system.description:
You have 10 [Inventory Slots]. When you receive the effect of [Food], the rating of your [Fatigue] is further reduced by 15. [Trigger: Refer] Use when combat begins. You gain [Cancel (Poison, Radiance): 40]. At the end of combat you must roll once on the "Consumption Table: Goods". A bag that houses the Fairy of Gastronomy. Food placed inside becomes delicious beyond belief, and grants a blessing during battle. However, the fairy is a big eater, and will leave if not given offerings.

Supple Leather of the Divine Horse [Core Material] (380G) + Adventure Sack (480G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 15] (220G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (640G)
